item.title: Micro-Goals: From Overwhelmed to Shipped 🚀 • Identify one task you can complete in 30 minutes. • Break it into 3 smaller steps; write them down. • Set a timer for each step and focus only on that. • Complete the task and celebrate your progress! 🎉 • Use: “I completed X by breaking it into Y steps.” What micro-goal will you set today to turn your overwhelm into progress? #productivity #goals #ScalePilot #SocialPilot #AIAutomations
